note.en: Collision/streaming in lattice units Δx=Δt=1. Examples cover D2Q9 isothermal low-Mach shear waves and Poiseuille flow. Links the lattice-BGK/body-force/halfway-wall calculation to its macroscopic steady incompressible channel solution.

note.ja: 一定密度・粘性の代表形。周期2D MAC射影・Taylor–Green渦に加え、圧力を消去する非周期Re100キャビティを別配布で検証します。 格子BGK・体積力・半格子壁を使う計算と、巨視的な定常非圧縮流路解を結びます。
note.en: Representative constant-density/viscosity flow. In addition to periodic2D MAC projection/Taylor–Green, a separate release verifies a pressure-eliminated nonperiodic Re100 cavity. Links the lattice-BGK/body-force/halfway-wall calculation to its macroscopic steady incompressible channel solution.
